result.stdout:
Usage:
  novacore upgrade --plan <SolutionName> --to <FrameworkLine>
  novacore upgrade --apply <SolutionName> --to <FrameworkLine> --confirm <PlanFingerprint>

--plan produces a read-only upgrade plan and a fingerprint for a catalog-supported framework line after validating the current application composition.
--apply reacquires the application lifecycle lease, recreates the plan, and requires that exact fingerprint before atomically updating controlled files.
Neither command restores, builds, accesses the network, or loads application assemblies.
